notes.title: Tips and Future Updates
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Hope you've been enjoying the game!

For those of you who have been struggling, keep at it! Make sure you read all the notes you find and understand the subtle hints they give you to help you succeed!

Additionally, please know that you can left click to attack if you prefer to use it over the 'E' button!

Now, a little note about future updates for the game:

Unfortunately, I can't work on games full-time. I'm a full-time student with another part-time job, so game making is just something I can do when I have the free time. The reason I was able to build this game for all of you guys was because I had free time to build it over the summer and winter when I was not in school. So, I'm not certain when I'll have the time to update the game.

That being said, I plan on updating the game when I can! I intend on allowing flexibility in the control scheme for the game. I also will make minor changes to the actual game where necessary.

Thanks for playing everyone!

notes.title: Launch day!
notes.content:
Today's the day! The Cursed Tower is now available for everyone to enjoy, free of charge.

This game started as a learning experience for me, and, when development started, it was my first game. So, that's why I wanted to provide it for free to all of you. It was really fun to make, and I hope it's really fun to play too! I appreciate any and all feedback, good or bad. And even if you don't like it, thanks for giving it a try!

Please feel free to reach out to me if you have any questions or comments.

Have fun!!
